title: HAL Community Growth
description: Once daily, measure real public traction and choose at most one useful community action. Prefer contribution value over promotion.

steps.action: Measure repository stars, forks, outside contributors, issue/PR activity, and public demo evidence.
Check approved community/collaboration inbox threads for meaningful new replies.
Inspect current public AI-agent, MCP, local-AI, evaluation, and provenance discussions for a concrete HAL contribution opportunity.
Choose at most one highest-value useful action; otherwise record NO_CHANGE.
steps.condition: Action must be evidence-backed, non-spammy, and useful to the target community.

steps.action: Create a bounded proposal/artifact/issue candidate for review.
steps.condition: Only when a specific useful action passed the quality gate.
